note: Diagrams from Wikimedia Commons, stored locally. tools/fetch_commons.py fills licence, author, file and sha256 from the Commons API and refuses any licence not in the allowlist. Only entries with decision 'accepted' and a verified licence are shown; every other slot keeps its drawing from src/art.js. Shown diagrams are clinical content: they are hashed into the 'illustrations' review item by tests/release_gate.mjs.

items.decisionNote: Abdominal thrusts (Heimlich). ANZCOR 4 uses back blows then chest thrusts; abdominal thrusts are not taught. Most choking images on Commons show this. Not used.
Marked CC0, but its source is a picture from a commercial website, so the CC0 claim is doubtful. Not used.

gaps: Pressure immobilisation bandage and splint (snake, funnel-web): nothing suitable on Commons; images there show tourniquets.
Chest thrusts for choking (ANZCOR style): Commons has abdominal thrusts, and one chest-thrust image copied from a website.
Burns (cool running water 20 minutes), heat illness, poisoning, marine stings (vinegar), spider bites: no clear diagrams found.
